### Observed differences

- The relative order of two activity groups reversed. In the earlier window, A35, A36 and A41 ran before A26 and A27 in about 97–99 in 100 traces (each pair co-occurred in every trace); in the later window, A26 and A27 ran before A35, A36 and A41 in about 97–98 in 100 traces. [REL010, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015]
- Event positions moved consistently with this reversal: the median position of A35, A36 and A41 shifted from about 0.39–0.41 of the trace to about 0.59, while A27 moved from about 0.46 to 0.37 and A26 from about 0.61 to 0.53. [POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006]
- Successions were rewired around the reversed segment: A25 previously led to A35, A36 or A41 (about 38, 31 and 27 in 100 of its outgoing transitions) and now leads to A27 in about 96 in 100; A26 previously led to A30 in about 98 in 100 and now leads to A35, A36 or A41 (about 35, 32 and 31); A35, A36 and A41, which previously led to A27 in about 28–36 in 100 of their transitions, now lead to A30 in about 30–34 in 100 and almost never to A27. The internal order among A35, A36 and A41 itself looks similar in both windows. [DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, DIR009]
- Distances changed accordingly: A27 now follows A25 within one step in about 98 in 100 traces (before, it followed after 4–5 steps in essentially all traces), and A30 now follows A26 after 4–5 steps in about 98 in 100 traces (before, within one step in about 99 in 100). [LAG002, LAG005]
- A02 became far less frequent and dropped out of the late flow: it appeared in about 75 in 100 traces before versus about 21 in 100 after; before, about 91 in 100 of A02's outgoing transitions went to A50 and A49 led to A02 in about 72 in 100 of its transitions, whereas afterwards A49 leads directly to A50 (about 83 in 100, one step apart in about 84 in 100) and A02's output is spread thinly over many activities (A50 about 13 in 100). [OCC001, DIR001, DIR011, LAG009]
- A02's remaining occurrences sit earlier and more variably in the trace (median position about 0.97 before versus about 0.45 after), and the activities it used to accompany now run without it in about 79 in 100 traces. [POS001, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that the segment formed by A35, A36 and A41 moved from before A26 and A27 to after them: in the earlier window A25 fed the group and the group flowed on to A27, while in the later window A25 feeds A27 directly, A26 feeds the group, and the group flows on to A30. [REL010, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, DIR009, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, LAG002, LAG005]

The reversal is shown directly by relational evidence on six activity pairs, each with full co-occurrence and 200-trace support in both windows, and the positional, successor and distance items all point the same way; the screening volume (45 qualifying items against roughly 0.83 expected for an unchanged process) also cannot be explained by random re-splitting. [REL010, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, DIR009, LAG002, LAG005]

A competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out is a shift in the mix of two pre-existing trace variants that differ in this segment order, rather than a rewiring of a single flow; the aggregate windows also leave the relative order of A26 versus A27 themselves unresolved. [REL010, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015]

Other differences:
- A02 became rare and was bypassed at the end of the process: participation fell from about 75 to about 21 in 100 traces, A49 now flows to A50 without it, and its remaining occurrences sit earlier and more variably, usually without the mid and late activities it previously followed. [OCC001, DIR001, DIR011, POS001, LAG009, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009]
- A06 and A10 participate in more traces than before (about 7 versus 19, and 9 versus 22 in 100), but this rests on modest support (13–17 traces before, 38–43 after). [OCC002, OCC003]
